name: Mugshot
authority: This directory is Mugshot's brand authority. The app's immutable identity and tokens remain fixed; user-authorized OpenAI imagery and controlled poses are versioned here and supplied to the app. Marketing consumes the same kit.
scope: Brand imagery refresh and native pose catalog, implemented in source. This is not an app distribution, a marketing-site deployment, or evidence of physical-device or TestFlight acceptance.

positioning.description: A personal sip journal for the drink, the place, and the little moment around it.
positioning.status: Source-derived synthesis of native onboarding, not a new product claim.
positioning.audience: People who want to remember their drinks, return to favorite cafes, and choose what they share with friends.
positioning.promise: Help people remember what they enjoyed and what they want to try next.

principles.title: The moment comes first.
principles.body: Lead with the drink and its memory. Ratings and interface details support the story.

principles.title: A journal at your pace.
principles.body: Use inviting, specific language. Keep social sharing a choice and preserve audience meaning.

principles.title: Warmth, with room to breathe.
principles.body: Use cream surfaces, espresso typography, gentle green accents, and generous space.

principles.title: Mugsy is a companion.
principles.body: Use the existing character to guide and acknowledge. Keep his permanent identity intact.

color_usage.creamWhite: Primary page canvas. The warm surface that connects app and marketing.
color_usage.foamWhite: Cards, fields, and text on the accessible dark sage action color.
color_usage.espressoBrown: Primary type, editorial headings, and high-contrast marks.
color_usage.roastBrown: Body copy, supporting text, and readable secondary information.
color_usage.mugshotMint: Accent panels and selected context. Pair with espresso text.
color_usage.mugshotSage: Decorative sage and large graphic elements. Do not use with white for small text.
color_usage.mugshotSageText: Accessible action fill and green text on cream, foam, and sand.
color_usage.sandBeige: Quiet panels, secondary surfaces, and grouped controls.
color_usage.mugshotLine: Quiet separators. Insufficient by itself to identify an essential input boundary.
color_usage.mugshotMatcha: Supporting drink-context accent, not a replacement primary green.
color_usage.mugshotLatte: Supporting warm accent for drink context.
color_usage.mapPinHigh: High-rating map meaning. Always accompany with a number or label.
color_usage.mapPinMiddle: Middle-rating map meaning. Always accompany with a number or label.
color_usage.mapPinLow: Low-rating map meaning. Always accompany with a number or label.
color_usage.sageGray: Legacy alias of mugshotMint; do not create a separate color.

typography.native_body: System sans; semantic text styles where implemented. Respect Dynamic Type.
typography.font_files: No font binaries are bundled with the native app. No external fonts are part of this kit.
typography.portability: System faces vary by platform. Georgia and Times are fallbacks, not an assertion of exact SF Serif parity. PDF reference exports use built-in Times and Helvetica.

web_roles.purpose: One main marketing statement; regular serif.
Serif section headings with natural wrapping.

logo.wordmark_rule: Use live text in the native regular serif role. There is no separately approved vector wordmark in the app.
logo.clear_space: Web application rule: leave at least one quarter of the displayed icon width around an icon/name lockup; retain all padding inside the source PNG.
logo.minimum: Web application rule: use the full icon at least 48 CSS px wide; use a text-only name if the embedded mug loses clarity.
logo.lockup_gap: Web application rule: use the app's 12 px spacing step between the displayed icon and name.
logo.backgrounds: Prefer cream or white. The original icon includes its own white canvas; do not fake transparency on dark backgrounds.
prohibited: Adding a new badge or tagline inside the mark
logo.gap: No approved standalone vector logo, inverse logo, monochrome master, CMYK master, or favicon-size redraw exists in the audited app. Keep these as explicit gaps rather than inventing replacements.

rules: MugsyIdentityMaster freezes the original front-facing Mugsy artwork byte-for-byte. It is the reference for every new pose, not a pose to redraw.
White ceramic, the same asymmetric body, rim, right-side handle, glasses, cheek placement, thin limbs, and compact feet stay fixed.
Seven native identity shapes are locked by SHA-256. The renderer shares them across all 18 configurations.
Only expression, gaze, articulated limbs, liquid, outfits, and named accessories vary. Props never replace anatomy or hide the glasses.
Every generation references the immutable master. Full prompts and generation provenance are saved. No identity is recursively re-created from another generated pose.
Each PNG must have true alpha, complete clear margins, a square canvas, an exact reviewed hash, and a recorded optical identity review.
Alpha-derived display registration makes poses fit consistently without altering or cropping the PNG source.
Generated artwork and code-native renders share semantic pose mappings. They are distinct renderings, not a claim of pixel-identical output.
Use native geometry for dynamic product states and generated PNGs for static illustration. Native core construction stays authoritative.
Use the builder only for coming-soon or maintenance. Keep accessories context-specific and expressions positive.
Artwork colors remain separate from UI tokens. Never recolor the ceramic body.
Original legacy rasters are archived under identity/legacy-originals; outdated baked onboarding panels are excluded from the current kit.
character.motion: Quiet at rest, responsive to interaction, briefly expressive on completion. No ambient mascot loop in marketing. Honor reduced motion with a still pose.

rules: Use the five current OpenAI-generated photographic-style brand scenes supplied in assets.json. They replace the old drink, latte, cafe, and orange-peel imagery.
Photographic realism means plausible ice and condensation, fine milk texture, natural light, real material detail, and restrained color. Avoid glossy synthetic rendering and excessive garnish.
These are fictional illustrative brand scenes, not captured customer drinks, named real cafes, testimonials, or release evidence.
Keep source PNGs intact. Responsive display crops may preserve the drink focal point; do not distort images.
Use solid cream behind text when image contrast would be uncertain.
Use current named Mugsy poses with the immutable identity contract; do not generate a new Mugsy identity.
Legacy baked onboarding composites remain historical native resources and are not the current brand imagery or screenshots of a new build.
No personal journal, private note, live account, or production service data enters the imagery.

voice.profile: Warm, concrete, observant, and unhurried. Short serif-worthy headlines; plain explanatory body copy; verbs that describe what happens next.
voice.perspective: Speak to the person as you. Use we only for a real Mugshot action or responsibility. Mugsy is a named companion, not the narrator of every sentence.
voice.rhythm: Favor short statements and natural fragments in headlines. Follow with one useful sentence. Keep UI labels literal.
voice.capitalization: Mugshot, Mugsy, Map, Feed, Saved, Journal, Friends, Favorites, Want to Try, Lists. Sentence case in new copy; preserve the sourced Capture Every Sip headline.
voice.spelling: Always cafe and cafes, using ASCII e.
avoid: Guilt, streak pressure, or forced social sharing
Invented user counts, rankings, reviews, awards, availability, or pricing
Promises that every sip is automatically public
Claims that all app content is private regardless of selected audience

tones.rule: Warm and specific. Lead with the memory and let the person choose.
Literal action, useful object, clear outcome.
Calm acknowledgement. Celebrate the completed action, not a promised future save.
Say what is known, what remains safe, and the next available action. Use no blame.
Use exact audience semantics. Separate private notes from a post's chosen audience.

voice.privacy: Private means owner-only. Friends means confirmed mutual friends. Everyone means public. Private notes stay private. Describe the selected audience rather than promising blanket privacy.

copy.text: The drink. The place. The little moment around it. Mugshot helps you remember it all.
Coffee, matcha, tea, and everything between. Mugsy keeps the little moments that would otherwise disappear.
Never forget the cafe you meant to try.
Favorites, Want to Try, and Lists keep the next plan one tap away.
A memory, not just a rating.
Keep the photo, the feeling, the recipe, and the details you would otherwise forget.
Your people. Your pace. Your privacy.
Private notes stay private. Choose who can see each post you share.

governance.change_rule: Any identity change updates this kit, its source mapping, the changelog, and affected consumers in the same reviewed change. Do not create a competing palette or voice guide in a downstream repository.
governance.versioning: Patch: clarification or export repair. Minor: compatible addition. Major: changed identity, semantics, or a breaking token contract.
acceptance: No fabricated product or release claims
Marketing reference checked against the kit
governance.consumer_rule: Pin the kit version and source commit. Import tokens.css; use the manifest assets and copy library. Record adoption before claiming the marketing site conforms.
